title: Add release team `open_sound_control`
author: chrisib
body:
* Name of the new release team: `open_sound_control`
* Release repositories to add: `open_sound_control-release`
* Team members
  * [@chrisib](https://github.com/chrisib/open_sound_control_ros/blob/e2164bd4449db41283f53626c8bbfddf3be72440/open_sound_control_bridge/package.xml#L8)

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: Hi @chrisib, before we create a release team and repository, can you please [index your package](https://docs.ros.org/en/jazzy/How-To-Guides/Releasing/Index-Your-Packages.html) so that the package goes through naming and license review. Thanks.

comments.author: chrisib
comments.body: I believe that check was done when I initially tried blooming the package in this (now-closed MR): https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/44782#pullrequestreview-2695392526

comments.author: christophebedard
comments.body: Maybe I'm mistaken, but, by "indexing the package," we mean having a `source:` entry under your package in rosdisro and no `release:` entry (`doc:` may be added then or later): https://docs.ros.org/en/jazzy/How-To-Guides/Releasing/Index-Your-Packages.html#make-changes-to-your-fork. If you open a new PR with just that part, we can officially go through the checklist and merge it. Then this can proceed and later you can actually release the packages.

comments.author: chrisib
comments.body:
The package is now indexed. See the MR referenced above.

_____
Edit

Whoops, I just noticed it was you who approved & merged it. Ignore me telling you things you probably already know lol.

comments.author: christophebedard
comments.body:
> Whoops, I just noticed it was you who approved & merged it. Ignore me telling you things you probably already know lol.

I indeed know, but I myself can't help with this step, so it's still good that you commented here to give an update.

comments.author: chrisib
comments.body: Is there anything else that I need to do before the `needs rosdistro source link` tag gets removed? Or it's just a matter of being patient and eventually someone will attend to it?

comments.author: christophebedard
comments.body: Yeah, I believe @nuclearsandwich checks every once in a while.
